_comment: The protocol verb set, and the source of truth for it. src/gates/bd.ts ENFORCES this set, by calling `commentVerb` and comparing against these entries -- one implementation, so the guard and the parser cannot disagree. Two hand-written copies restate it: skills/orchestrate/references/message-grammar.md for humans, and the `Verbs you may write` sentence of DISPATCH_CONTRACT in src/contract.ts for workers. test/grammar-parity.test.ts fails when the gate's set, that reference, or the contract's list diverges from this file in either direction, so edit here first and let the test name what else must move. The contract lists exactly the entries whose writers are not `extension`; the extension's own notices are the rest. A verb is what `commentVerb` in src/bd.ts yields: strip a leading run of bullet, blockquote, emphasis, tick and strikethrough markers, take the first whitespace token, strip trailing emphasis, ticks and sentence punctuation, uppercase. Case and ordinary markdown are therefore free; only the first token counts. Nothing else in a comment is protocol. A non-verb is warned, not refused, and only inside an active run. One carrier per fact: the bead's status, assignee and labels hold state, and one comment verb records each transition. There is no audit-record double write and no `state:` label. Adding a verb here without a writer and a source is how a vocabulary rots. NO_WORK is deliberately absent: it is a yield-payload token matched by src/gates/exit.ts, never a comment, because an empty queue leaves no bead to write on.

writers.unlisted: generic.json's `agent: *` fallback: any claimant with no per-role contract
writers.extension: this plugin's own code, not an agent. Named by `source.where`. Never in the contract's writable list

source.contract: migrated exactly from the named role-contract predicate. Machine-enforced on yield
source.code: the named src file writes this verb. Machine-observable, not contract-enforced
source.inferred: no contract or code constrains the writer. `where` cites the prose the narrowest defensible set was read from -- a reviewer may disagree with the set without disagreeing with the verb

_vocabulary.terminal: true when writing the verb ends the attempt it describes: the writer yields, or its claim is released. A non-terminal verb annotates work that continues

verbs.meaning: Evidence delivered, next role's label added, assignee cleared -- the node's exit contract is met.

Work cannot proceed. A worker writes it on an escalation wisp linked to its node; a shepherd writes it on the merge bead, naming the gate, provider or slot the landing waits on. Never stored as a bead state.

source.where: all six: escape.require. Also reviewer.json completion.verdict, researcher.json completion.answer, shepherd.json completion.disposition

verbs.meaning: Unrecoverable failure. A valid exit paired with status blocked, never a faked success.
One reviewer's verdict, written on the node its review wisp links to. The review outcome a reader needs is this comment: approve or changes at a named head and round.
The merge bead's branch is merged and metadata.merge_sha is stamped.
The merge attempt is refused back to its origin as a fix bead: bot findings, scope drift, or a branch that no longer merges into its base. The reason token says which.
A repeated review issue exhausted its fix-attempt limit. The merge bead is held for a human: status blocked, and this comment carries the ASK fields.
A product-intent question only a human can settle. The hold is status blocked plus this comment; a bead not yet started also gets a human gate.

source.where: all six: escape.require, so a held bead is a valid exit. Blocked clause of src/contract.ts DISPATCH_CONTRACT; references/lifecycle.md human-in-the-loop

verbs.meaning: A durable observation without a state transition: a discovered bead's id, a bead-local default and its revisit trigger, a researcher's answer on the linked node, the reaper's record of a claim it preserved and why.

source.where: researcher.json: completion.answer on the linked node. Every other writer is prose: references/lifecycle.md incidental bug beads, references/beads-store.md bead-local defaults, src/supervision.ts reapBead (NOTE claim preserved)

verbs.meaning: The extension released a dead holder's claim under the lease: the holder's terminal frame, or registry aborted plus a lapsed lease, fenced by --claim. The bead is open and unassigned again; requeue is implicit.

source.where: src/lease.ts releaseDeadClaim, called from src/supervision.ts reapBead

verbs.meaning: A claimed child went silent past its threshold. No kill -- the spawner decides.
A degraded preflight or a settings deviation the run should see but not stop for.
The run objective and its status, stamped on every epic each time it changes.
